name: 3x-ui
description: 3X-UI panel integration. 3X-UI is installed under /usr/local/x-ui with its configuration and database in /etc/x-ui.
ssl_method: acme.sh issuance into BaToHub state storage; the certificate is registered with the panel CLI only when that CLI reports support for certificate options
template_method: the panel serves subscription content from its own web settings; BaToHub stages template files and never edits the panel database
